images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original cartoon illustration embedded in the Eyeron Notation3 user guide, displayed at page width and on phones. Style: polished editorial comic with expressive rounded characters, crisp navy ink contours, soft gouache shading, light warm ivory background, generous breathing room. Restrained accents drawn from the project palette: bright green #48e654, coral #ff472f, cyan #22bde7, yellow #fcfa44. Recurring character: a friendly small ivory robot with a single wide cyan eye visor, a green indicator light, rounded hands and short navy boots; an approachable curious adult learner with short curly dark hair and a coral sweater. Warm, witty and welcoming, with real narrative clarity. Landscape composition about 3:2, no lettering, no text, no speech bubbles, no brand logos, no watermarks, no charts requiring tiny labels. All important shapes should read at a small display size. Primary request: the learner and the robot welcome an elderly bearded philosopher in a simple pale robe to a playful logic workshop. The philosopher carries one blue fact card and one yellow rule card; the robot slides them onto a small workbench, and a new green conclusion card lights up beside a small lightbulb. Card faces contain only simple abstract dots and connectors. One cohesive story scene, not a screenshot. Convey curiosity, discovery, and the delight of seeing a conclusion follow from facts and a rule. Keep the scene grounded and uncluttered.
